svg.title: Client stack
svg.desc: Focused dependency views. Repeated modules provide context; each relationship appears once. Nodes: webauthn-client-compose; webauthn-client-platform — (androidMain and iosMain); webauthn-client-json-core; webauthn-client-prf-crypto — (optional); webauthn-client-defaults — (recommended composition); webauthn-client-ktor-kotlinx — (default JSON contract); webauthn-client-ktor — (codec-neutral transport); webauthn-client-flow; webauthn-client-core; webauthn-json-api; webauthn-json-kotlinx; webauthn-runtime-core; webauthn-model. 1. webauthn-client-compose → webauthn-client-core. 2. webauthn-client-compose → webauthn-client-flow. 3. webauthn-client-compose → webauthn-client-platform (androidMain and iosMain). 4. webauthn-client-compose → webauthn-json-kotlinx: androidMain. 5. webauthn-client-defaults (recommended composition) → webauthn-client-platform (androidMain and iosMain): androidMain and iosMain. 6. webauthn-client-defaults (recommended composition) → webauthn-json-api. 7. webauthn-client-defaults (recommended composition) → webauthn-json-kotlinx. 8. webauthn-client-platform (androidMain and iosMain) → webauthn-client-core. 9. webauthn-client-platform (androidMain and iosMain) → webauthn-json-api. 10. webauthn-client-json-core → webauthn-client-core. 11. webauthn-client-json-core → webauthn-json-api. 12. webauthn-client-prf-crypto (optional) → webauthn-client-core. 13. webauthn-client-prf-crypto (optional) → webauthn-runtime-core. 14. webauthn-client-ktor-kotlinx (default JSON contract) → webauthn-client-ktor (codec-neutral transport). 15. webauthn-client-ktor-kotlinx (default JSON contract) → webauthn-json-kotlinx. 16. webauthn-client-ktor (codec-neutral transport) → webauthn-client-flow. 17. webauthn-client-flow → webauthn-client-core. 18. webauthn-client-core → webauthn-runtime-core. 19. webauthn-client-core → webauthn-model.
